title: Speaking of Trust - Speech as a Measure of Trust
reasoning: The paper dedicates a significant section, '5 ETHICAL IMPLICATIONS', to a detailed discussion of the moral and ethical consequences of using speech to measure and manipulate trust in human-robot interaction. This includes potential for misuse, privacy violations, and reinforcement of stereotypes. The abstract and discussion also frame the ethical considerations as a core part of the paper's contribution, going beyond a brief, standard 'limitations' section.
